description: Get market-wide campaign-finance rollups across every tracked politician for a cycle: total raised, top 10 individual donors, top 10 PACs, party/chamber/cycle splits, and a most-funded politician leaderboard. Answers questions like "who are the biggest donors in 2024?" or "which party raised more?".

cycle.description: Election cycle as 4-digit year (e.g. "2024"). Defaults to most recent cycle. FEC cycles are even years (2022, 2024, 2026); an odd year matches no cycle and returns no donors, and a year outside 1980-2100 is replaced by the current cycle.

name: get_donor_aggregates
title: Get Donor Aggregates
